reason: I get abayas off Shein or TikTok Shop for like $20 to $30, so $45 for an everyday one, or $75 to $80 for a thobe, is a lot for me even with 15% off. I'm not driving out to Westchase just to look at stuff I can't really afford right now.
objection: From what's listed it sounds like crepe thobes, bishts and jalabiyas, which feels more Arab or Gulf style and kind of plain for me. I don't see anything that looks like what I'd actually wear, and the prices are double what I usually pay.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing actual pieces on TikTok that look like my style (colorful, trendy, not just black or Gulf-style) with an everyday abaya around $30, or a real sale where I could get one under $35.
